falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern typically saw shallow drawdowns with strong support at higher levels; a break below 4,800 would violate the structural support characteristic of that bottom formation, invalidating the pattern match and suggesting a deeper correction than the model implies

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug was marked by volatility compression and VIX peaking near 28-30 before rapid normalization; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic selling and systemic stress inconsistent with a bottoming pattern, suggesting instead a capitulation phase or bear market acceleration

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts further by >25bps from current level (more negative)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom coincided with steepening yield curve dynamics as rate-cut expectations built; further inversion signals deteriorating growth expectations and potential credit stress, directly contradicting the macro conditions that enabled the 2024 bottom to hold

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
